extDescription.message: Chrome side panel that embeds the local DeepSeek Harness agent GUI and attaches the current page to it.

hintStartDsh.message:
$1

Hint: start `dsh web` first (or install the native host so it can auto-start), then click “Retry”.

gatePermissionBody.message: A one-time grant is needed to read the text and screenshots of any web page. Everything stays on this machine (written into your workspace and handed to your local DSH) — nothing goes to any service outside this extension.

statusNotGranted.message: Not granted yet: click the extension icon once on the target page (that grants the tab temporarily), then retry.

statusBrowserControlOn.message: Browser control is on: clicks and typing use real input events (Chrome shows a “being debugged” banner while it runs).

statusBrowserControlOff.message: Browser control is off: the debugger was released.

statusWriteOpsOn.message: Write actions are on: the model can see $1 browser tools ($2).

statusWriteOpsOff.message: Write actions are off: the model only has read-only tools.

gateAsk.message: Every click and typing first asks for approval (per the default policy; a session set to “never” is refused outright).

gateNoApprovalService.message: This deployment has no approval service: only this switch gates write access.

gatePolicyNever.message: Approval policy is “never”: no prompt appears and write actions are refused outright (set the policy back to “ask” first).

gateApprovalOff.message: Approval is disabled in the configuration.

browserControlTitle.message: Uses the DevTools protocol to send real input events (trusted click/type, full-page screenshots, accessibility tree). While it is on, Chrome shows a “being debugged” banner.

writeOpsTitle.message: Lets the agent click, type and navigate in your pages (browser_click / browser_type / browser_navigate). Off by default — these tools are only registered for the model after you turn it on.

errNoHostPermission.message: This page is not authorized yet: click “Grant & capture” to grant “read all websites” once, or click the extension icon on the target page (that grants the tab temporarily) and retry.

errNoSelection.message: No selection detected: select some text on the page first, then click “Attach selection” — or use “Attach page” to capture the whole page.

errDshDown.message: The local DSH is not running: start it with `dsh web`.

errReadonly.message: This action needs write access: turn on the “Write actions” switch in the panel (only then are the click/type/navigate tools registered for the model).

errExtOffline.message: The browser extension is not connected: open the side panel (the /ag/agent channel only exists while the panel is open).

errTargetBusy.message: The target tab is held by another debugger (usually another extension debugging that page): close that debugger and retry.

errTimeout.message: Timed out: $1. The page may still be loading; try again in a moment.

shotNoImage.message: Screenshot failed: the extension got no image at all (the page text was still delivered).

shotFailedWithReason.message: Screenshot failed; the page text was still delivered: $1

shotEmptyImage.message: Screenshot failed: the image was empty (the page text was still delivered).

dshDownNoNativeHost.message: DSH is not running and the native host is not installed. Run `node native-host/install.mjs` first, or start `dsh web` manually.

dshAutoStartFailed.message: DSH is not running and auto-start failed: $1

errNotPaired.message: The extension and the plugin are not paired yet — run `node scripts/init-key.mjs` and reload the extension.

errTicketFailed.message:
Could not get a one-time entry ticket ($1): $2

Automatic entry was stopped so that the long-lived key never enters the iframe URL. Reopen the side panel to retry; if it keeps failing, run `node scripts/init-key.mjs` and reload the extension.
